reports.title: Generate Biomedicines Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Business Update

desk.headline: Revenue $4.2m and loss of $0.68 a share, both short of estimates; cash $404.2m; no guidance
results: Partnership revenue fell to $4.2m from $9.6m as work for Amgen and Novartis nears completion; the estimate was $7.8m.
The net loss widened to $87.7m ($0.68 a share) as R&D rose 32% to $82.3m, mainly on two late-stage asthma trials of GB-0895. The year-ago per-share loss was on a much smaller pre-IPO share count.
Cash fell to $404.2m from $457.4m in June; with the $30m Zealand payment, the company says it is funded into the first half of 2028.
In October it signed an obesity-drug deal with Zealand Pharma: $30m upfront and up to about $1.2bn in milestones, plus royalties.
It also announced a research collaboration with a leading AI developer on CAR T-cell therapy design, and dosed the first patient in its ovarian-cancer CAR T trial.

guidance.summary: Generate gives no revenue or earnings guidance. It only says its cash should last into the first half of 2028 and that it will need more capital later.

watch: Progress of the two late-stage GB-0895 trials in severe asthma, and any decision on COPD.
Milestone payments from Zealand and any new partnerships.
Cash burn against the runway into the first half of 2028.
